rationale: The source is a mature brainstorm with 8 closed decisions. Research targets its explicit VERIFY markers and codebase-answerable open questions: (a) the GraphIndex backend contract and whether it shares a seam with BaseWikiStore (OQ1), (b) the exact ground_claim signature for evidence_ref (OQ2), (c) the existing BM25/re-ranking seam over pgvector that hybrid_search must plug into, (d) whether the store contract test suite is backend-parametrized (OQ4), (e) SQLite store port surface (WIKI_SCHEMA_SQL, _MIGRATION_COLUMNS, SCHEMA_VERSION), (f) asyncpg pool/schema conventions for a new graphindex.* schema.
